_: The court's pace (court.js). stages: by the share of the reign's clock gone (until), the seasons between full sittings (every) and how many matters a sitting hears, as [count, chance] pairs (want). noClock: a reign without a clock. petitions: the reign's petitions setting shifts every and want (rare: fewer, more seldom; often: more, sooner), within wantMin..wantMax. handYear: seasons between the Hand calling the King in for a crisis between sittings (an ultimatum always comes).
